scope: Descriptive source inspection after this outer seed selection. No holdout results accessed; no novelty claim; source is unchanged.
label: Halton exploration, incumbent perturbations and regularized quadratic fitting
first_point: Deterministic Halton point at index zero mapped into the legal box.
subsequent_points: Mix a Halton point with local incumbent perturbations; when enough observations exist, optionally propose a perturbed stationary point from a fitted full quadratic.
incumbent: Uses the best observed point as the local-search center and its value as the model-improvement threshold.
adaptation: For t=history_length/31, Halton probability falls from 0.5 toward 0.1 and local Gaussian scale is 0.3/sqrt(1+4*t) times coordinate width. The quadratic branch has fixed 0.05-width Gaussian perturbations.
history_statistics: Fits intercept, linear terms and all quadratic cross terms to the full history through normal equations, ridge 1e-6 and Gauss-Jordan elimination. Requires p+2 observations, with p=6 in 2D and p=15 in 4D.
quadratic_rule: Solve C*x=-b/2, clip the stationary point and use it with probability 0.5 if predicted value improves the incumbent. There is no positive-definiteness check, so this stationary point need not be a model minimum.
local_rule: Local branch uses independent Gaussian steps with probability 0.8; otherwise one shared ratio-of-Gaussians jump scales all coordinates.
boundary_handling: Halton mapping stays within bounds; quadratic, Gaussian and heavy-tailed proposals are clipped coordinatewise.

lineage.description: The sixth generated proposal is selected by validation; final export retains all attempted parent-child diffs.
